striker.desc: STRIKER (STRK) is our exclusive in-game token used for all bets and rewards.
striker.note: STRK has a fixed peg to TON with a small spread to support platform liquidity and jackpot pools.

deposit.step1: Tap the Wallet icon in the bottom navigation bar.
deposit.step2: Enter the amount of TON you wish to deposit.
deposit.step3: Click 'Deposit' to create an invoice via CryptoBot.
deposit.step4: Complete the payment directly within Telegram.
deposit.step5: STRIKER tokens are credited to your balance automatically!

games.shot: Ball flies and multiplier grows. Cash out before it crashes. Last-second cashouts win big!
games.penalty: Choose left/center/right. 1.92× payout if keeper dives the wrong way.
games.freekick: Ball drops through pegs. Low risk: smaller swings. High risk: big wins or big losses.
games.minefield: Click safe squares on a 5×5 grid. Cash out before hitting a mine. More safe squares = higher multiplier.

vip.note: Cashback is calculated on net losses and paid out weekly. Minimum wagering requirements apply for each tier level.

withdrawal.desc: Withdrawals are processed manually by our team for security reasons. Standard processing time is ~24 hours.
withdrawal.critical: CRITICAL: You must have a @username set in your Telegram profile to receive payments.

referral.desc: Share your unique referral link found on the Profile page.
referral.earnDesc: Earn 5% of your friend's first deposit as STRIKER tokens instantly!

jackpotDesc.intro: The Golden Boot Jackpot is a community-wide prize pool that grows with every single bet placed on the platform.
jackpotDesc.note: Once the pool reaches 50 TON, it is randomly awarded to an eligible player who has been active in the last 60 minutes. Every bet is a chance to win!

verify.title: Provably Fair
verify.subtitle: Verify any crash round outcome
verify.howDesc1: Before each round, the server generates a random serverSeed.
verify.howDesc2: The crash point is computed as HMAC-SHA256(serverSeed, "crash") and cannot be changed after the round begins.
verify.howDesc3: The seed is revealed only after the round crashes, so you can verify the result was predetermined and fair.
verify.fairMessage: The outcome matches — this round was fair.
verify.manualDesc: Enter any server seed to compute its crash point independently.
verify.openSource: Crash formula is open source and verifiable by anyone
verify.roundNotCrashed: Round is not crashed yet — seed revealed only after crash
verify.networkError: Network error — make sure you are logged in
